caption:
📚 Hard vocab word #17: EXIGENT

exigent (adjective): requiring immediate attention; urgent.

✅ In a sentence: The exigent circumstances of the storm forced officials to skip normal procedures.
✅ Similar: urgent, pressing, critical
✅ Remember it: Noun: exigency (an urgent need).
